subject: MAP: org tenancy & environment wiring — API key rotation, IP allowlist, VPC peering
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@medburst.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP: MedBurst POC — environment details we need

Sergio / Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week. MedBurst is ready to move to a short POC and we'd like to capture a mutual action plan so both teams are aligned on the environment wiring we need to validate. High-level asks from our side: 

1) API keys & org setup: we need a scoped API key for the staging tenant and confirmation of a dedicated org/tenant for our POC. Keys must be rotatable; please include a recommended rotation cadence.
2) IP allowlist: our corp firewall will only allow a fixed set of outbound IPs. Can you provide an allowlist and a /24 or set of IPs we can use during the trial window?
3) VPC peering / connectivity: we prefer a VPC peering route (shared VPC or peering) for low-latency token exchange. Need a proposed peering window and any network config requirements.
4) Timeline: MedBurst is aiming for a feature validation week starting 2027-06-21. We need the environment ready by 2027-06-18 to run integration tests.

Attached is our internal network sheet and a short security checklist from our NetOps team (we'll loop them in separately). Can you send a concise MAP doc with owners and dates so we can sign off?

Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Engineering, MedBurst
alex.chen@medburst.com

---
Attachment: medburst-network-inventory.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP: MedBurst POC — environment details we need

Alex — thanks for the clear list. I've drafted a compact MAP attached (map-draft-v1.pdf) that maps each deliverable to an owner and target date. Summary here: 

- API key & org tenancy (owner: Sergio Alvarez) — We'll provision a dedicated staging org and issue a scoped API key by 2027-06-11. Keys will be issued with a 90-day default rotation; we can shorten to 30 days if you require. We support key revocation immediately on request.

- Org-level roles & access (owner: Neha Kapoor) — We will create a MedBurst org with two admin seats and three developer seats for the POC; Neha will send onboarding steps and SSO hints by 2027-06-10.

- IP allowlist (owner: Marissa Cole) — Marissa will provide a recommended ephemeral allowlist (two IPs + CIDR ranges for peering) by 2027-06-11. If you need static /24 allocation we can reserve a CIDR from our peering pool; expect NAT'd egress.

- VPC peering window (owner: Grace O'Connor) — Grace proposes a peering window on 2027-06-16 or 2027-06-17 (2-hour window) to finish routing and firewall rules. We will supply BGP/route table snippets and a basic MTU/keepalive checklist.

I attached a simple network-diagram.png to show the planned topology. Next step: Alex, if you confirm the 2027-06-16 peering window (or propose an alternate), we'll lock the MAP and send a HubSpot/DocuSign link for sign-off.

Thanks — we'll try to keep the MAP one page so your execs can review quickly.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai

Looping in the implementation notes here so we have a single record for the MAP: 

- Org onboarding: I'll create the MedBurst org and send the invite flow (SSO optional) by EOD 2027-06-10. Expected items from MedBurst: admin identity email (+ SAML metadata if SSO) and the list of developer accounts.

- API key rotation: default 90 days; for POC we'll issue a pair of keys (primary + standby) on 2027-06-11 and provide a short script for safe rotation. I'll include revocation steps in the invite email.

- IP allowlist draft: suggested egress IPs for our staging pool: 34.128.12.16, 34.128.12.17 and peering CIDR 10.200.0.0/16 (NAT applies). If MedBurst requires a dedicated /24 we can request allocation but that adds coordination. Marissa — can you validate these with our network ops?

- Peering: Grace, I'll need the peering GUID and the exact routing prefixes to include in the org-level firewall template.

Neha
